notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.3.8: fixes the Windows taskbar icon by taking the exact icon Windows already displays for the MXB Race Day Live desktop shortcut and applying it directly to the live app HWND. A fresh AppUserModelID bypasses stale Python/Tk shell caching; WM_SETICON sets both large and small taskbar icons, the top-level class icons are updated, and the icon is re-applied after window mapping so Tk/Windows cannot replace it during startup. If the shortcut cannot be found, Race Day Live falls back to any local packaged ICO it can locate. Existing Garage, performance optimizations, updater/restart, one-click joining, memberships, wallet, race economics, track artwork, results and admin controls are preserved.
